tasks.short: Check applicants against the vacancy requirements and pass suitable candidates to the recruiter or hiring manager.

today.trigger: A new application arrives in Recruitee for a warehouse, transport or office vacancy.
steps: Read the application, CV and approved vacancy requirements.
Check stated experience, required certificates, preferred site and shift availability.
Ask the applicant to clarify missing information.
Record the assessment in Recruitee and refer candidates to the recruiter or hiring manager.
drudgery: Repeatedly finding the same facts in differently formatted CVs.
Copying application details into assessment notes.
Chasing missing information and referral responses.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 76.9 hours per administrator annually. Reading, checking and chasing are inferred time sinks; the actual split needs observation.

lenses.faster: Extract relevant facts into a requirements table with links to the original passages. Copying and repeated searching disappear; the administrator checks the evidence and missing facts.
lenses.autonomous: Each new application generates a factual briefing and flags unanswered questions. It cannot reject, rank or hide candidates automatically.
lenses.ambitious: Give every application a consistent review and clarify missing shift or certificate information promptly. Test whether this improves hires who become productive and remain after 90 days.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive CV reading and copying. Keep conversations with applicants and the judgment needed when experience does not fit a standard template.
lenses.options: Show requirements met, requirements needing clarification and requirements that could be met through training. Offer several clarification questions without assigning a suitability score.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the requirements checklist and audit extracted facts and referrals. Improve the process when good candidates are overlooked or managers receive incomplete information.
reach: Prepare factual candidate briefings for recruiters.
Coordinate certificate clarification with the Learning and Development Specialist.
Maintain consistent screening checklists across the three sites.

tasks.human_edge: A person distinguishes missing evidence from lack of ability, considers transferable experience and takes responsibility for referral decisions.
tasks.pattern_why: The person remains the lead because selecting applicants affects employment opportunities. An llm_step can extract evidence, while explicit rules check completeness; neither makes the selection.

in_practice.trigger: A new or updated application enters a designated Recruitee stage.
steps: Retrieve the approved vacancy checklist and only the relevant application documents.
Extract stated facts into fields with source passages; mark unsupported facts as unknown.
Apply explicit completeness checks without scoring or ordering applicants by suitability.
Let the administrator inspect the original evidence and draft clarification questions.
Have the authorized reviewer record the referral decision and move the candidate in Recruitee.
in_practice.human_gate: Every referral or rejection requires meaningful review of the application by the authorized administrator or recruiter, with authority to disagree with the briefing.
systems: Proposed restricted integration and approved LLM service
data_needed: Job-specific requirements approved by the recruiter and hiring manager.
Application documents and candidate-declared site and shift preferences.
Certificate requirements and approved training alternatives.
Reviewer permissions, applicant privacy information and retention rules.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted Recruitee assessment notes and integration audit records containing source references, checklist version, corrections and reviewer decisions.

evidence.claim: Recruitee supports job requirements, screening questions and evaluation kits; this does not establish that the proposed evidence extraction is available or accurate.
Extracting source-linked facts from applications into a review table is technically plausible, but needs a local accuracy and fairness pilot.
The 50% effort saving and 1.6 times task speedup are planning assumptions, not measured results.

risks: Extraction errors, biased requirements or reviewer overreliance can exclude suitable candidates; inspect source evidence and sample decisions.

AI used to filter or evaluate applicants can fall within the EU AI Act's high-risk employment category. Human review does not automatically remove that classification; assess the intended use before deployment. [European Commission: Employment AI](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/recital-57)

AVG/GDPR restrictions apply to consequential automated decisions; keep meaningful human assessment and a route to challenge decisions. [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens: Human review of decisions](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/basis-avg/privacyrechten-avg/recht-op-een-menselijke-blik-bij-besluiten)
Applicant documents may contain irrelevant sensitive information or instructions aimed at the model; treat documents as data and restrict extraction to approved fields.
research_questions: On a representative sample of warehouse, transport and office applications, how often does extraction miss or invent a required fact?
Does the briefing reduce review time without increasing missed referrals or encouraging reviewers to rubber-stamp its output?
Which requirements are genuinely necessary at entry, and which can be satisfied through training?
What AI Act classification, DPIA, applicant information and OR involvement does the proposed use require?

tasks.short: Tell applicants the hiring decision and explain their next steps.

today.trigger: The recruiter or hiring manager records an approved acceptance or rejection.
steps: Check that the decision and any offer terms are approved.
Choose an appropriate message and insert candidate and vacancy details.
Check reasons, attachments, recipient and next steps.
Send the message, record it in Recruitee and handle replies.
systems: SharePoint approved message and offer templates
drudgery: Repeatedly merging names, roles and dates into messages.
Checking whether a message has already been sent.
Copying sent messages and follow-up tasks between systems.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 73.2 hours per administrator annually. Message preparation and status checking are inferred time sinks; difficult conversations remain.

lenses.faster: Merge approved facts into approved templates and record delivery automatically. Routine drafting, copying and duplicate checks disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An authorized decision triggers the matching message and next-step task. Missing approvals, changed offer terms and sensitive rejections enter an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Give every applicant timely closure and every accepted candidate clear instructions before day one. Track unanswered offers and failed deliveries before they delay onboarding.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive message administration. Keep personal calls, candidate questions and support when a decision is disappointing or complicated.
lenses.options: Maintain approved variants for early rejection, post-interview rejection and acceptance, with suitable language versions. Personal feedback uses only reviewer-approved reasons.
lenses.altitude: Own message quality, delivery monitoring and exception handling. Improve templates using candidate questions and avoidable onboarding confusion.
reach: Manage recruiter communication queues.
Coordinate the handover from accepted offer to onboarding.
Track outstanding candidate responses for recruiters.

tasks.human_edge: People deliver difficult feedback, explain decisions and resolve questions about offers without making unintended commitments.
tasks.pattern_why: The decision is already made and approved. Templates, field validation, routing and delivery records can run without a model; sensitive personalization remains human.

in_practice.trigger: An authorized user records a final decision and marks its communication as approved in Recruitee.
steps: Check the decision, approved template, recipient and any offer approval.
Merge allowed fields and verify required dates, terms and attachments.
Route sensitive feedback or nonstandard terms to the administrator.
Send the standard approved message once and record its delivery status.
Create the response or onboarding task and flag failed deliveries.
in_practice.human_gate: The recruiter or hiring manager approves the underlying decision and offer terms before the trigger. Standard messages then send automatically; exceptional messages require individual approval.
data_needed: Authorized final decision and approved reason category.
Candidate contact details and communication language.
Approved offer details and next-step instructions.
Template versions, exception rules and unique send identifiers.
in_practice.logs_to: Recruitee candidate communication history, with decision approver, template version, send identifier, delivery status and exception resolution.

evidence.claim: Recruitee supports automated emails and other actions associated with candidate disqualification reasons.
Acceptance messages and onboarding handovers can use rules and approved templates, subject to the account's available triggers and integrations.
The 75% effort saving and 2.5 times task speedup assume most communications use approved standard templates.

risks: An accidental stage change can send the wrong message; require an explicit communication approval and prevent duplicate sends.
An acceptance message may create expectations or commitments inconsistent with approved terms; lock substantive offer wording.
Automating notification must not become automated candidate selection; preserve the underlying human decision.
Generic or invented rejection reasons damage trust; send only approved reasons and route sensitive feedback to a person.
research_questions: What percentage of messages already fit a standard approved template?
Can the installed Recruitee plan distinguish a decision from authorization to communicate it?
Can queued messages be stopped reliably when decisions or offer terms change?
Does faster communication improve offer acceptance and week-one onboarding completion?

tasks.short: Help employees with benefits, sickness-related administration and workplace accident claim paperwork.

today.trigger: An employee asks about a benefit, a lifecycle change affects eligibility, or sickness or an accident creates administrative work.
steps: Identify the request and whether Noordhaven or a staffing agency is responsible.
Check the employee record, applicable CAO and approved benefit rules.
Collect necessary administrative information and prepare forms or explanations.
Ask Payroll, Compensation and Benefits, or the HR Business Partner to resolve exceptions.
Record approved changes and follow up with the employee or relevant provider.
drudgery: Finding the correct rule and effective version.
Re-entering employee details into forms.
Chasing missing paperwork and specialist decisions.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 71.6 hours per administrator annually. The Dutch interpretation is benefits, sickness administration and accident or insurer paperwork; no US workers' compensation scheme is assumed.

lenses.faster: Retrieve the applicable approved rules and prefill administrative forms from AFAS. Repeated searching and copying disappear; entitlement exceptions and sensitive conversations remain.
lenses.autonomous: A recorded lifecycle event opens the relevant checklist and calculates administrative due dates. Proposed benefit changes and external submissions wait for approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check every eligible lifecycle event for overlooked benefits and incomplete paperwork. Extend consistent support to shift workers who rarely access office channels.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated form filling and reminder chasing. Keep helping employees understand their choices and reach the right specialist.
lenses.options: Show approved benefit choices and their documented payroll consequences. Present administrative routes for direct employees and agency workers without deciding medical fitness or liability.
lenses.altitude: Maintain eligibility tables, source documents and exception categories with the specialists. Monitor where requests stall or employees receive conflicting answers.
reach: Prepare routine benefit enrollment packs for the Compensation and Benefits Specialist.
Collect approved payroll mutation evidence for the Payroll Specialist.
Track nonmedical absence administration deadlines for the HR Business Partners.

tasks.human_edge: Employees need clear explanations and discretion; specialists retain entitlement, payroll, legal and medical judgments.
tasks.pattern_why: Requests span employee records, CAO rules, forms and specialist handovers. Rules handle known eligibility, an optional llm_step structures questions, and a person approves consequential changes.

in_practice.trigger: A structured employee request or relevant approved AFAS lifecycle change opens a case.
steps: Determine employment relationship, responsible employer and request category.
Retrieve only necessary AFAS fields and effective approved CAO or policy rules.
Calculate rule-based eligibility or deadlines and flag ambiguity.
Prepare the form, explanation and proposed administrative action.
Obtain specialist approval before any entitlement, payroll or external submission change.
Record completion and follow up on missing administrative items.
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll or Compensation and Benefits approves financial changes; the HR Business Partner handles disputed cases. Medical assessment stays with the bedrijfsarts or arbodienst, and liability decisions stay with the designated legal or insurance owner.
systems: SharePoint approved rules and restricted case records
data_needed: Employment type, applicable CAO, contract dates and relevant approved payroll fields.
Benefit rules, effective dates and specialist ownership.
Only permitted nonmedical absence dates and administrative status.
Agency responsibility agreements and required form fields.
Approved access, retention and escalation rules.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted AFAS case records and an approval register recording rule versions, proposed actions, approvals and submissions, without diagnoses.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can expose administrator-selected records and fields for an integration.
Power Automate supports approval workflows across services; the proposed benefit workflow still requires configuration and validation.
The 45% effort saving and 1.5 times task speedup depend on codifiable rules and a substantial share of routine requests.

risks: The two CAOs, effective dates and agency arrangements can produce different entitlements; stop when applicability is unclear.

Employee sickness messages may disclose diagnoses. Employer records and model inputs must exclude medical details that HR may not process. [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens: Sick employee privacy](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/zieke-werknemers/regels-voor-werkgevers-bij-zieke-werknemers)

Deadline reminders support Wet verbetering poortwachter administration but do not replace professional case management. [UWV: Sickness steps in your calendar](https://www.uwv.nl/nl/magazines-nieuwsbrieven/nieuwsbrief-werkgevers/stappenplan-zieke-werknemer-in-uw-agenda)
Accident claim paperwork must not delay the responsible owner's urgent reporting duties or determine employer liability.
research_questions: Which request categories account for most administrative time, and which require specialist judgment?
Can both CAOs and benefit policies be converted into approved, versioned rules without unresolved ambiguity?
Can medical information be excluded from intake, logs and model processing in practice?
Who owns each deadline, external submission and agency-worker handover?

tasks.short: Publish approved vacancies and make sure eligible colleagues hear about them.

today.trigger: An approved vacancy needs internal publication, external advertising or an update.
steps: Collect approved role, site, hours, shift, pay and certificate requirements.
Prepare the vacancy using the current template and obtain recruiter approval.
Publish through Recruitee and the selected advertising channels.
Notify eligible internal workers through available site channels.
Check publication, correct errors and close or update advertisements.
systems: SharePoint templates and internal vacancy pages
drudgery: Copying the same vacancy into channel-specific formats.
Checking site, shift and pay information repeatedly.
Tracking publication failures and expired advertisements.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 54.9 hours per administrator annually. Reformatting and channel checking are inferred time sinks; job-board publication delays remain outside HR's control.

lenses.faster: Generate channel versions from one approved vacancy record. Repeated copying and separate internal notification preparation disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An approved vacancy triggers publication and internal announcements through configured channels. Failed submissions, changed terms and paid campaigns go to the administrator.
lenses.ambitious: Give all three sites consistent, accurate vacancies and ensure shift workers receive internal opportunities. Compare channels using productive, retained hires rather than application volume alone.
lenses.joy: Remove reformatting and publication checking. Keep improving clarity with recruiters and finding ways to reach colleagues on shifts.
lenses.options: Prepare several wording and channel combinations within approved facts and budgets. Include plain-language and reviewed translation variants where applicants need them.
lenses.altitude: Maintain vacancy templates, publication rules and a channel checklist. Monitor missing fields, failed postings and internal reach across sites.
reach: Manage recruitment campaign administration for recruiters.
Coordinate internal mobility announcements with HR Business Partners.
Prepare channel data for the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.

tasks.human_edge: Recruiters and managers decide what the role requires and what the company promises; administrators understand how each site's workers receive information.
tasks.pattern_why: An llm_step can draft variants, while software validates approved facts and publishes them. A person approves wording, terms, audience rules and spending before publication.

in_practice.trigger: A vacancy is marked ready for preparation with its required approvals.
steps: Read the approved vacancy record and check mandatory fields and applicable CAO references.
Prepare external and internal versions while preserving pay, hours, site and requirements.
Obtain recruiter approval for the final text, channels and any budget.
Publish through Recruitee and distribute approved internal notices through site-accessible channels.
Check channel acceptance and route failures or inconsistent versions for correction.
Update or close postings when the authorized vacancy status changes.
in_practice.human_gate: The recruiter approves each new vacancy's wording and publication plan; the budget owner approves paid advertising. Material changes require renewed approval.
systems: Proposed drafting service and notification workflow
data_needed: Approved vacancy fields, CAO applicability and pay wording.
Channel credentials, publication requirements and budget limits.
Internal vacancy policy and approved eligibility rules.
Site communication routes accessible to shift workers.
Vacancy status and channel tracking identifiers.
in_practice.logs_to: Recruitee job records and a restricted publication register containing approved text versions, channels, costs, publication status and closure actions.

evidence.claim: Recruitee can submit published jobs to job boards, but boards impose their own requirements and publication can take up to two days.
Recruitee provides internal job publication options.
The 65% effort saving and two times task speedup assume reusable vacancy records and reliable internal distribution.

risks: Drafts can alter salary, shift requirements or certificate expectations; validate substantive fields against the approved vacancy.
Email and Teams alone may miss warehouse and transport workers; confirm accessible internal channels at each site.

An AI system that targets job advertisements based on personal characteristics may enter the AI Act's high-risk recruitment category; assess such targeting separately. [European Commission: Employment AI](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/recital-57)
Channel delays and inconsistent updates can leave stale vacancies visible; verify actual publication and withdrawal.
research_questions: How much of the current work is already handled by Recruitee templates and publishing features?
Which internal channels reliably reach workers on every shift at Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo?
Can one approved record supply all required job-board fields without manual rewriting?
Can channel outcomes be linked reliably to hires who are productive and retained after 90 days?

tasks.short: Find employee information and provide only what an authorized requester is allowed to receive.

today.trigger: An employee, authorized manager or external organization requests employment information.
steps: Verify the requester, purpose and authority to receive the information.
Locate the employee record and relevant documents.
Check current facts, disclosure scope and applicable template.
Prepare the limited response and obtain approval where required.
Send through an approved channel and record the disclosure.
drudgery: Searching across employee records and document folders.
Copying employment facts into standard statements.
Checking permissions and recording each disclosure.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 53.8 hours per administrator annually. Search and document preparation are inferred time sinks; external authorization must still be checked.

lenses.faster: Retrieve approved fields by employee identifier and populate a purpose-specific statement. Folder searching and manual transcription disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A structured request generates an authorization check and a draft disclosure pack. Unverified requesters receive no employee information.
lenses.ambitious: Make routine employment statements consistently quick and auditable. Detect missing or contradictory records before they cause repeated requests.
lenses.joy: Remove searching, copying and disclosure logging. Keep helping employees resolve unusual requests and understand what can be shared.
lenses.options: Prepare a minimal employment confirmation, a permitted income statement or an employee-facing document pack according to the request. Do not offer a full file as a default.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the request catalogue, field allowlists and access rules. Review exceptions and disclosure logs to improve service and data quality.
reach: Prepare approved employment and income confirmations with Payroll.
Resolve routine employee master-data discrepancies with the HRIS Analyst.
Manage standard HR information requests for HR Business Partners.

tasks.human_edge: A person judges ambiguous authority and purpose, prevents excessive disclosure and explains refusals or limitations.
tasks.pattern_why: Retrieval and template merging are deterministic. Verifying an external request and approving disclosure require a accountable person; no model is needed for routine structured requests.

in_practice.trigger: A structured request is submitted through an authenticated internal route or entered after external identity verification.
steps: Check requester identity, purpose, authority and permitted request type.
Resolve the employee identifier and retrieve only allowlisted current fields.
Populate the approved statement and flag contradictory or missing facts.
Have the administrator inspect the disclosure scope and approve release.
Deliver through the approved secure route and record what was disclosed.
in_practice.human_gate: Every external disclosure requires approval of identity, authority, purpose, recipient and fields. Predefined authenticated internal self-service can be considered separately after access testing.
data_needed: Employee identifier and authoritative current employment facts.
Verified requester identity and documented disclosure authority.
Purpose-specific field allowlists and approved templates.
Recipient verification, delivery and retention rules.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted disclosure register recording requester, purpose, authority, employee identifier, fields released, approver, recipient and delivery time.

evidence.claim: AFAS administrators can define GetConnector datasets and restrict the records and fields exposed to integrations.
Purpose-specific retrieval, template merging and disclosure logging can be implemented with conventional software.
The 70% effort saving and 2.5 times task speedup assume standard requests dominate and approvals are available promptly.

risks: A request from a credit bureau, lender or finance company is not itself authorization to disclose; verify the specific lawful basis and authority.
Incorrect employee matching or stale salary facts can harm employees; use stable identifiers and authoritative records.
Broad search access can expose BSN, bank details, absence information or unrelated documents; use purpose-specific field allowlists.
Automation identities and delivery channels must preserve employee-level access restrictions and avoid unrestricted document links.
research_questions: Which request types recur, and what exact fields may each requester receive?
How are external identity, lawful basis and employee authorization currently verified?
Can AFAS expose only the required fields without allowing broader employee-file access?
Does the proposed process reduce handling time while preventing wrong-recipient and excessive disclosures in realistic tests?

tasks.short: Prepare reliable HR reports and personnel documents for managers and the HR team.

today.trigger: A scheduled reporting date or an authorized request requires HR figures or personnel documents.
steps: Clarify the audience, reporting period, measures and document purpose.
Collect AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and relevant agency data.
Reconcile identifiers, dates, headcount definitions and missing records.
Prepare tables, charts or documents and check totals.
Share the approved output and answer questions about its meaning.
drudgery: Repeating extracts and spreadsheet joins.
Recalculating the same measures and formatting the same reports.
Explaining discrepancies caused by different cutoffs or definitions.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 48.9 hours per administrator annually. Reconciliation and formatting are inferred time sinks; existing Power BI coverage may already remove part of them.

lenses.faster: Reuse validated extracts, joins, measure definitions and document templates. Recurring spreadsheet assembly and formatting disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A successful refresh triggers data-quality checks and the standard report. Failed reconciliations stop publication and create an exception for review.
lenses.ambitious: Produce a weekly hire-to-day-90 view covering onboarding, certificates, retention and manager-confirmed productivity. Include site and employment-type breakdowns when sufficiently complete and safe to share.
lenses.joy: Remove recurring spreadsheet repair and formatting. Keep investigating anomalies and helping managers understand what the figures support.
lenses.options: Offer consistent views by site, role group, cohort and direct or agency employment. Show explicit scenarios for staffing assumptions without presenting them as forecasts.
lenses.altitude: Own report definitions, reconciliations and publication checks with the HRIS Analyst. Improve the information process instead of rebuilding each report.
reach: Maintain recurring HR reporting operations for the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Prepare certificate and onboarding exception lists for Learning and Development.
Provide reconciled workforce counts to the Controller and FP&A Analysts.

tasks.human_edge: A person explains missing data and business context, challenges misleading comparisons and distinguishes evidence from speculation.
tasks.pattern_why: Recurring joins, calculations, reconciliations and report layouts are checkable rules. An optional llm_step can draft commentary from validated aggregates, but cannot invent measures or explanations.

in_practice.trigger: The scheduled reporting cycle starts after required source refreshes complete, or an authorized standard report is requested.
steps: Load approved datasets and record each source's cutoff and refresh status.
Join records using maintained identifiers and calculate versioned measures.
Check completeness, totals, agency separation and access restrictions.
Generate the standard report and any clearly marked commentary draft.
Publish approved recurring factual reports when checks pass; route anomalies and new analyses for review.
Record publication and corrections so later reports use the same definitions.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator handles failed checks and approves narrative interpretations. The HRIS Analyst approves new measures and joins; sensitive or new audience distributions require review.
systems: Power BI and nightly AFAS extract
Approved Recruitee and Studytube exports or integrations
data_needed: Versioned definitions of headcount, absence, time to hire and 90-day retention.
Candidate-to-employee and employee-to-learning identifier mappings.
Start dates, vacancy outcomes and agency assignment periods.
Week-one onboarding evidence and manager-confirmed productivity status.
Source cutoff dates, reconciliation totals and audience permissions.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted reporting run register with source timestamps, definition versions, reconciliation results, exceptions, published file links and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors provide structured retrieval that can support repeatable reporting pipelines.
Validated joins, scheduled calculations and templated reports can run without a language model.
The 80% effort saving and four times task speedup assume repeatable reports and usable cross-system identifiers.

risks: Nightly AFAS data must not be presented as live information; display source-specific cutoff times.
Agency workers, direct employees and multiple assignments can be double-counted or assigned the wrong denominator.
Certificates and retention do not establish productivity; collect an explicit, agreed productivity measure.
Small groups or individual absence details can identify employees; restrict access and suppress unsafe breakdowns.
Do not turn descriptive reporting into individual suitability, performance or absence-risk scoring without a separate legal and AI Act assessment.
research_questions: Which reports still require manual work despite the existing Power BI dashboards?
Can candidate, employee, learning and agency records be linked reliably at the required grain?
How will Noordhaven define productive after 90 days, including late starters and incomplete cohorts?
Do automated checks catch the discrepancies found in several previous reporting cycles?

tasks.short: Keep HR handbooks, forms, directories and organization charts accurate and current.

today.trigger: An approved organizational, policy, CAO or form change occurs, or a document review date arrives.
steps: Identify documents affected by the approved change.
Check authoritative employee data, policy sources and current templates.
Edit the relevant chart, directory, handbook or form.
Obtain the document owner's approval and complete applicable OR procedures.
Publish the current version, archive superseded material and notify affected users.
drudgery: Updating the same names, reporting lines or policy wording in several places.
Finding outdated copies and broken links.
Chasing document owners for reviews and approvals.
today.time_sinks: The supplied baseline is 45.1 hours per administrator annually. Duplicate editing and version checking are inferred time sinks; policy decisions and consultation remain.

lenses.faster: Regenerate factual directories and charts from approved AFAS fields, and prepare source-linked document changes. Duplicate editing and manual version comparisons disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Approved record changes or review dates create update proposals for affected documents. Policy text and substantive form changes wait for the responsible owner's approval.
lenses.ambitious: Keep a dependable document set across all three sites, with clear ownership and accessible versions for shift workers. Find conflicting guidance before employees rely on it.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated name changes, formatting and reminder chasing. Keep making guidance understandable and resolving contradictions with policy owners.
lenses.options: Prepare a full policy, a plain-language employee explanation and a manager checklist from the same approved source. Translations remain linked to the authoritative version and receive review.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the document register, authoritative sources, review dates and approval routes. Improve the publishing system so outdated copies are easier to detect and retire.
reach: Coordinate policy publication for HR Business Partners and the HR Director.
Maintain training-related document references with Learning and Development.
Manage HR document ownership and access reviews with the HRIS Analyst.

tasks.human_edge: Policy owners decide substantive wording and employee implications; administrators make it understandable and ensure the required approval and consultation have occurred.
tasks.pattern_why: Factual updates can use deterministic software, while an llm_step prepares proposed text changes. The mixed task needs a gate because handbook and evaluation-form edits can change employment policies.

in_practice.trigger: An approved source change or a document review date creates an update job.
steps: Use the document register to identify affected files, owners and approval requirements.
Retrieve approved source versions and generate factual updates or proposed text changes.
Check conflicting wording, effective dates, personal-data exposure and broken references.
Show a comparison to the owner and confirm any required OR process is complete.
Publish the approved version, update links and archive superseded controlled copies.
Notify affected audiences and retain the source-to-document change record.
in_practice.human_gate: The responsible owner approves each revised document before publication. Substantive policies or evaluation forms also follow the applicable legal and OR process; factual regeneration can later receive a narrower approved exception.
systems: Optional approved LLM service for proposed wording
data_needed: Document register with owners, review dates and source dependencies.
Approved CAO and policy versions with effective dates.
Permitted directory fields and approved reporting relationships.
Publication audiences, access rules and authoritative document links.
Required approval and OR completion records.
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint version history plus a restricted change register recording source versions, proposed changes, owner approvals, applicable OR records and publication dates.

evidence.claim: SharePoint content approval can keep pending documents unpublished, and Power Automate can route approval and set the approval status.
Source-driven chart generation and proposed document changes are feasible, but Noordhaven's dependency mapping and templates would need to be built.
The 65% effort saving and 2.5 times task speedup assume controlled templates and identifiable document owners.

risks: Generated wording can silently change an entitlement or policy; review substantive changes against the approved source.

Changing personnel-data arrangements or employee monitoring can require OR consent; do not publish before the applicable process is complete. [SER: Employee privacy and participation](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/belangrijke-themas/privacy)
Factual charts and directories can reveal unnecessary personal information; restrict fields and audiences.
Downloads, printed copies and translations can remain outdated after SharePoint publication; maintain clear version dates and replacement instructions.
research_questions: How many documents have a named owner, authoritative source and dependable review date?
Can AFAS reporting relationships generate charts without extensive manual corrections?
Which handbook and form changes require OR consent or another formal approval?
Can employees on every shift identify and access the current version, including translated or printed guidance?

role.altitude: The HR Administrator becomes the owner of dependable HR administrative workflows: maintaining rules, checking evidence, resolving exceptions and ensuring approved actions reach employees and candidates.
reach: Recruitment communication and publication operations, with recruiters retaining hiring decisions.
Benefit enrollment preparation and payroll mutation evidence, with specialists retaining financial decisions.
Nonmedical absence deadline administration, with HR Business Partners and occupational professionals retaining case judgments.
Onboarding and certificate exception coordination with Learning and Development.
Recurring report operations and data-quality checks with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Reconciled workforce information for the Controller and FP&A Analysts.
HR policy publication and controlled document maintenance for the HR Director and HR Business Partners.
role.ceiling_note: The seven tasks cover 424.4 hours per FTE annually, or 848.8 hours across both administrators, approximately 26.5% of role time. Applying the proposed effort savings gives about 535 hours of annual capacity worth EUR 25,666 at EUR 48/hour, before implementation, maintenance and added work; this is an estimate, not a cash saving or a basis for removing a position. All current workflows are inferred from the supplied context. Savings describe steady-state human effort; speedups describe the complete individual administrative task, including its checks and approvals, rather than the whole recruitment or absence journey. Reach is limited by this released capacity, access permissions, specialist decision rights and the quality of source data.
skills_to_grow: Write and maintain explicit rules, checklists and acceptance checks.
Understand AFAS field definitions, connector permissions and effective dates.
Configure and troubleshoot approved workflow tools, including any additional Power Automate licensing.
Check model extractions against source evidence and recognize biased or unsupported suggestions.
Apply the two CAOs and distinguish direct-employee from staffing-agency responsibilities.
Handle AVG/GDPR access, minimization, disclosure and retention requirements.
Coordinate applicable OR procedures and recognize when an AI use needs a separate AI Act assessment.
Maintain reporting definitions and explain incomplete or conflicting data.
Design communication routes that work for employees on shifts.
role.ambitious_version: Run a joined administrative service from vacancy approval through day 90 across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Approved events trigger accurate messages, document packs, onboarding checks and certificate follow-up; administrators resolve exceptions and improve the rules with specialists. Use the released capacity to investigate missed week-one onboarding and delayed productivity, and assess success through productive hires retained after 90 days, alongside offer acceptance, absence and manager satisfaction.
